GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47) SC/PO
(SCAPIN - 1744/36)
APO 500
11 March 1952
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1744, as amended, subject as above, dated 14 July 1947.
2. So much of paragraph 12a, subparagraph (1) of the reference memorandum as pertains to amateur services is hereby rescinded.
3. The Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers has no objection to the establishment and operation of amateur radio stations in Japan subject to applicable Japanese laws and regulations and subject to the provision of frequencies for amateur radio operations in accordance with the provisions of SCAPIN 1744, as amended.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C. C> B. WARDEN,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
